aboutGame.title: What is DAWN AEROWAR?
paragraphs: DAWN AEROWAR is an interactive animated film about Zodiac 1, a fighter pilot flying a final escort mission across the Saal'Runa Empire. Its aerial combat is staged in cinematic 3D, while intimate moments in the cockpit use hand-drawn 2D art and a full English voice cast.

The experience runs nearly two hours across 12 episodes. You can choose episodes from the War Room map or watch the film uninterrupted in Cinematic Mode, then explore dossiers, communications, and other materials between flights.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about DAWN AEROWAR.

items.question: What is DAWN AEROWAR?
items.answer: DAWN AEROWAR is an interactive animated film about Zodiac 1, a fighter pilot flying a final escort mission against the Saal'Runa Empire. It combines cinematic 3D aerial sequences, hand-drawn 2D character art, and a full English voice cast.

items.question: Is DAWN AEROWAR a game or a movie?
items.answer: It is a film first. The interactivity comes from the War Room map, where you select episodes, review materials, and choose Cinematic Mode if you want an uninterrupted movie-style watch.

items.question: How long is DAWN AEROWAR?
items.answer: The film runs nearly two hours across 12 episodes, with interactive materials including 12 intelligence dossiers and 458 archived radio transmissions.

items.question: Who are the main characters in DAWN AEROWAR?
items.answer: The central figures are Zodiac 1, the anonymous AWACS operator, and three Saal'Runa Empire aces: Reaper, Freya, and Miracle.

items.question: When does DAWN AEROWAR release?
items.answer: It launches on Steam for Windows on November 10, 2026, with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad support plus subtitles in five languages.
